findings.message: `LOWER(project) = 'requests' OR LOWER(project) = 'urllib3'` wraps the cluster column `project` in LOWER, so BigQuery can't use the clustering of `proj.web.downloads` to skip blocks.
findings.fix: Compare `project` itself, for example `project = 'requests' OR project = 'urllib3'`, if the stored values are written that way.
